scenes.say: Can you read your glasses prescription? Here's what sphere, cylinder, axis and add really mean.

scenes.en: Your main power. Minus = short-sighted. Plus = long-sighted.
scenes.say: Sphere is your main power. A minus number means short-sighted. A plus number means long-sighted.

scenes.en: Corrects astigmatism: the eye's front curves like a rugby ball.
scenes.say: Cylinder corrects astigmatism. That's when the front of the eye is curved more like a rugby ball than a football.

scenes.en: 0 to 180: the direction the cylinder power sits
scenes.say: Axis is a number from zero to one hundred and eighty. It tells the lab which direction the cylinder power must sit.

scenes.ta: ADD: 40 வயதுக்கு மேல் படிக்க கூடுதல் பவர்
scenes.say: Add is extra power for reading, usually needed after forty. It's used in bifocal and progressive lenses.

scenes.en: Your power can change. Get checked every 1–2 years.
scenes.say: Did you know? Your power can change over time. Get your eyes checked every one to two years, or sooner if things look blurry.

scenes.en: Free eye test at our store. One free lens remake if the power doesn't suit.
scenes.say: At our store, the eye test is free. And if the power doesn't suit you after a LenzKare eye test, we remake the lenses once, free.
